chosen_titles.rationale: Part I (Administration of the Government, Chapters 1-182) contains M.G.L. c. 3 where MA's legislative-agent / executive-agent lobbying registration and disclosure regime is codified (sections 39-50), matching the 2010 vintage structure.

notes: MA Justia tree is 4-level (Part > Title > Chapter > Section). Part I selected; pass 2 will descend into the title containing Chapter 3.
